institution: University College London — Department of Computer Science
sourceDescription: The current UCL Computer Science Academic staff page links its All staff (A–Z) roster to UCL Profiles filtered by Dept of Computer Science. All 23 result pages were traversed and every one of the 554 unique official profile IDs was frozen. The official result set deliberately mixes professors, lecturers, research fellows, honorary staff, PGTAs, technical and professional roles; no role-based filtering was applied during roster capture, and classification is deferred to the next audit phase.
